content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial permits a formal appeal, while retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable under this payer's rules. Similar claims show comparable results for appeals (4/12 paid) and unchanged submissions (4/11 paid), but an appeal directly contests the authorization denial rather than repeating the same deficient claim. A medical-necessity appeal using the supporting clinical documentation is the next appropriate step before considering patient responsibility or write-off.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
